```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const contacts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".welcome-contact"));

  function setOpen(contact, open) {
    contact.querySelector(".welcome-contact-name").setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
    contact.querySelector(".welcome-contact-popover").hidden = !open;
  }

  contacts.forEach(function(contact) {
    const button = contact.querySelector(".welcome-contact-name");
    function show() {
      contacts.forEach(function(other) { setOpen(other, other === contact); });
    }
    contact.addEventListener("pointerenter", function(event) {
      if (event.pointerType === "mouse") show();
    });
    contact.addEventListener("pointerleave", function() {
      if (!contact.contains(document.activeElement)) setOpen(contact, false);
    });
    contact.addEventListener("focusin", show);
    contact.addEventListener("focusout", function(event) {
      if (!contact.contains(event.relatedTarget)) setOpen(contact, false);
    });
    button.addEventListener("click", show);
    contact.addEventListener("keydown", function(event) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        button.focus();
        setOpen(contact, false);
        event.stopPropagation();
      }
    });
  });
  document.addEventListener("pointerdown", function(event) {
    contacts.forEach(function(contact) {
      if (!contact.contains(event.target)) setOpen(contact, false);
    });
  });
});
</script>
```

# Finding a Place to Live {#finding-a-place-to-live}

Finding an apartment in Dallas is fairly straightforward, but prices, incentives, and utility costs can vary significantly between neighborhoods and buildings. The information below covers where to search, common move-in specials, electricity, parking, and the fees you'll likely encounter before signing a lease.

::: {.panel-tabset}
## **Local Options** {#local-options}

### Local Options
These neighborhoods are great options if you want to live closer to the office, keep your commute short, and enjoy easy access to Dallas restaurants, shops, and things to do. The monthly rent prices shown are estimated neighborhood averages to help you compare options. Actual rent will vary by building, apartment size, amenities, availability, and move-in specials.

## **Suburban Options** {#suburban-options}

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const currency = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "USD",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0
  });

  document.querySelectorAll(".neighborhood-rent-section").forEach(function(section) {
    const buttons = Array.from(section.querySelectorAll(".bedroom-selector-button"));
    const status = section.querySelector(".bedroom-selector-status");
    const rents = section.querySelectorAll(".rent[data-one-bedroom][data-two-bedroom]");

    function showBedroomPrices(bedroom) {
      buttons.forEach(function(button) {
        const selected = button.dataset.bedroom === bedroom;
        button.classList.toggle("is-active", selected);
        button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", selected ? "true" : "false");
      });

      rents.forEach(function(rent) {
        const amount = bedroom === "2"
          ? rent.dataset.twoBedroom
          : rent.dataset.oneBedroom;
        const suffix = bedroom === "2"
          ? rent.dataset.twoBedroomSuffix || ""
          : rent.dataset.oneBedroomSuffix || "";
        const configuredPrefix = bedroom === "2"
          ? rent.dataset.twoBedroomPrefix || ""
          : rent.dataset.oneBedroomPrefix || "";
        const amountText = String(amount || "").trim();
        const prefix = configuredPrefix || (amountText.startsWith("~") ? "~" : "");
        const numericAmount = Number(amountText.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, ""));

        rent.replaceChildren();

        const label = document.createElement("span");
        const value = document.createElement("span");
        const period = document.createElement("span");

        label.className = "rent-label";
        value.className = "rent-value";
        period.className = "rent-period";

        label.textContent = bedroom + (bedroom === "1" ? " Bedroom" : " Bedrooms");
        value.textContent = Number.isFinite(numericAmount)
          ? prefix + currency.format(numericAmount) + suffix
          : "Price unavailable";
        period.textContent = "estimated monthly rent";

        rent.append(label, value, period);
        rent.classList.remove("is-changing");
        void rent.offsetWidth;
        rent.classList.add("is-changing");
      });

      if (status) {
        status.textContent = "Showing " + bedroom +
          (bedroom === "1" ? " bedroom prices" : " bedroom prices");
      }
    }

    buttons.forEach(function(button) {
      button.addEventListener("click", function() {
        showBedroomPrices(button.dataset.bedroom);
      });
    });

    showBedroomPrices("1");
  });
});
</script>
```

*Rough averages as of mid-2026. Rents vary by season, building, and current availability.*

::: {.callout-tip}
### **Rule of Thumb**
The closer you live to Uptown and McKinney Avenue, the higher the rent but the easier the commute. Richardson, Plano, and Frisco can cost less and offer more space, but they require a daily highway commute.
:::

### **PMG Recommendations for Housing** {#housing-recommendations}
Based on PMGers' experiences living in Dallas. Explore average ratings, reported commutes, amenities, and advice from the housing survey.

```{=html}
<p id="housing-recommendations-status" class="recommendations-status" role="status">Loading housing recommendations...</p>
<div id="housing-recommendations-container" class="recommendations-grid apartment-recommendations-grid"></div>
<div class="recommendations-actions">
  <button id="show-all-housing-recommendations" class="recommendations-button" type="button" hidden aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="housing-recommendations-container">Show All Recommendations</button>
</div>
<noscript>Enable JavaScript to view the housing survey, or <a href="data/employee-housing-recommendations.csv">download the survey CSV</a>.</noscript>
```
<br>
Tour in person when possible because quality can vary significantly within the same price range, especially in Uptown high-rises. A common starting guideline is to budget about 25–30% of income for rent.

::: {.callout-important}
Always ask about move-in specials before signing. Apartment locators may also know about unpublished specials or availability.
:::

## **Fees, Deposits, and Move-In Deals** {#move-in-deals}

Winter, especially November through February, is generally the slowest leasing season and the best time to negotiate. Summer is peak demand and usually has fewer concessions. However, it's important to note the more common move-in deals that you may see during your apartment search process

### **Deals on Housing**

| Area or Property Type | Typical Deal Level | What to Expect |
|---|---|---|
| Uptown and New High-Rises | Biggest deals | One to two-and-a-half months of free rent may be available when buildings are competing to fill new units. |
| Frisco and Las Colinas | Biggest deals | Newer high-rise and mid-rise buildings often offer aggressive incentives. |
| Richardson, Addison, and Older Plano Properties | Smaller but still useful | Waived administrative fees or reduced deposits are more common than large rent concessions. |

### **Apartment Fees** {#apartment-fees}

Always ask for the **total effective monthly cost**, not only the advertised base rent.

| Fee | Typical Cost |
|---|---|
| Administrative Fee | $150–$300 |
| Application Fee | $50–$75 per person |
| Amenity or Valet Trash Fee | $20–$30 per month |
| Pet Rent | $20–$35 per month, plus deposit |
| RUBS Utility Billing | Shared water and trash charges |
| Security Deposit |
| Garage Parking | $100–$200 per month (depends) |


:::{.callout-important}
Always ask about move-in specials before signing. Apartment locators may also know about unpublished specials or availability.
:::


## **Electricity** {#electricity}

Texas has a deregulated electricity market. Use [PowerToChoose.org](https://www.powertochoose.org/){target="_blank"}, the official Public Utility Commission of Texas comparison site, to compare plans by ZIP code.

- Start with a fixed-rate 12-month plan for more predictable billing.
- Compare the all-in rate at 1,000 kWh, not only the advertised teaser rate.
- Oncor delivers the electricity and reads the meter regardless of which retail provider you select.
- Air conditioning may run almost continuously during summer, so budget for higher electric bills from June through September.


:::

::: {.section-dark}
# Getting Around Dallas {#parking-and-transportation}

Uptown high-rises commonly charge **$100–$200 per month** for a reserved garage space, although some properties include surface parking. Suburban complexes in Plano, Frisco, and Richardson are more likely to include parking at no extra cost. 

However, previous GLP classes have emphasized the need to make sure whether the parking is inside the apartment complex or not!

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Major Highways

# **Transportation Rule of Thumb**
US-75 is the route most associated with unpredictable congestion. The Dallas North Tollway is often more reliable but costs money via Toll Tag.

## **Public Transit and TollTag** {#dart-tolltag}

| Item | Cost | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| ***DART (Three Hour Pass)*** | $3.00 | Valid for 2.5 hours. Purchase through the GoPass app. |
| ***DART (Day Pass)*** | $6.00 | Unlimited rides on rail, buses, and GoLink for the day. Confirm current pricing in the app. |
| ***NTTA TollTag*** | Free Registration + Lower Toll Rates | Used for cashless tollways, including the DNT, President George Bush Turnpike, DFW Air and SH-161. It can also be used for parking at the DFW Airport. |

The Dallas–Fort Worth area offers two primary ways to get around: DART for public transportation and the NTTA TollTag for driving on toll roads.

* **DART (Dallas Area Rapid Transit)**: DFW's public transportation system, providing light rail, buses, streetcars, and GoLink on-demand services throughout DFW; utilizes the GoPass app; convenient option for commuting without a car.

* **NTTA TollTag**: Free electronic toll collection sticker issued by the North Texas Tollway Authority; allows drivers to pay tolls automatically on participating toll roads without stopping; typically provides lower toll rates than paying by mail.

# Getting Settled in Texas

Getting settled in Texas means preparing for the weather and checking a few practical tasks off your list. Explore the tabs below for what to expect throughout the year, how to register your vehicle and update your driver's license, and other details to help you feel at home in Dallas.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## **Weather in Texas** {#weather}

<div class="weather-grid">

<div class="weather-card weather-summer">

### Summer

<div class="weather-highlight">

95–105°F

</div>

Hot and humid from roughly June through September. Air conditioning runs nearly nonstop, and electricity bills can rise substantially.

</div>

<div class="weather-card weather-fall">

### Fall

<div class="weather-highlight">

Best Weather

</div>

October and November usually bring warm days, cooler nights, and lower humidity. Generally the most pleasant time of year.

</div>

<div class="weather-card weather-winter">

### Winter

<div class="weather-highlight">

40s–60s°F

</div>

Usually mild but unpredictable. Ice storms or hard freezes can shut down roads and schools. Keep a coat and blanket in your car.

</div>

<div class="weather-card weather-spring">

### Spring

<div class="weather-highlight">

Storm Season

</div>

Spring is beautiful but volatile. Severe thunderstorms and tornadoes are possible, so keep weather alerts enabled.

</div>

</div>

## **Register Your Vehicle** {#vehicle-registration}

Texas requires new residents to register their vehicle within 30 days of moving to the state. For most GLPers living in Dallas, this process will be completed through the Dallas County tax assessor-collector's office.

### **Follow This Order**

The order matters. Complete these steps before applying for your Texas driver's license:

1. **Confirm Texas-compliant auto insurance**
2. **Complete an emissions inspection**, if required for your county
3. **Register and title your vehicle** at your county tax office
4. **Apply for your Texas driver's license** through Texas DPS

Dallas County is an emissions-testing county, so most applicable non-commercial vehicles must pass an emissions inspection before registration. Texas eliminated the general safety inspection requirement for most non-commercial vehicles in 2025.

### **If a Parent Is Gifting You the Vehicle**

If your vehicle is currently titled in a parent's name and they are transferring it to you as a gift, complete the **Affidavit of Motor Vehicle Gift Transfer (Form 14-317)** as part of the title-transfer process.

A qualifying gift between a parent and child is generally subject to a **$10 Texas motor vehicle gift tax** rather than the standard motor vehicle sales tax. Both the donor and recipient must sign the required gift-transfer documents, and the paperwork is submitted through the county tax office.

Bring the documents required for your situation, which may include:

- Out-of-state title or other proof of ownership
- Application for Texas Title and/or Registration (Form 130-U)
- Affidavit of Motor Vehicle Gift Transfer (Form 14-317), if applicable
- Proof of insurance that meets Texas minimums
- Photo identification
- Vehicle Inspection Report, if the inspection is not already available electronically

::: {.callout-important}
### **Plan Ahead for Appointments**

DMV, county tax office, inspection, and DPS appointment availability can fill up quickly, especially around busy moving periods. Check appointment requirements and availability as soon as you know your move date rather than waiting until your first week in Dallas.
:::

## **Emissions Inspection** {#emissions-inspection}

### Complete an Emissions Inspection {#emissions-inspection}

Dallas County requires qualifying vehicles to pass an emissions inspection before registration. Texas eliminated the general safety inspection requirement for most non-commercial vehicles in 2025, but emissions testing still applies in Dallas and several other Texas counties.

## **Driver's License** {#license}

After completing your vehicle requirements, schedule your Texas driver's license appointment through the Texas Department of Public Safety. Completing the vehicle process first helps ensure you have the Texas registration documentation needed as you establish residency.

### Getting a Texas Driver's License {#texas-drivers-license}

Apply through the Texas Department of Public Safety. Bring:

- Proof of identity
- Social Security number
- Two proofs of Texas residency



## **Optional Registrations**

### Register to Vote {#register-to-vote}

You may register when obtaining a Texas ID or through the appropriate state registration process.

### Texas Minimum Auto Liability Coverage {#auto-insurance}

| Coverage | Minimum |
|---|---:|
| Bodily injury per person | $30,000 |
| Bodily injury per accident | $60,000 |
| Property damage | $25,000 |

This is commonly summarized as **30/60/25**. Confirm that your out-of-state policy meets these minimums before registering your vehicle.

:::

# Getting Set Up in the Office {#getting-set-up-in-the-office}

The Dallas office is a vibrant and welcoming environment where new employees can quickly feel at home and connected to the team. Our team is committed to providing a supportive and collaborative workspace that helps everyone thrive. With that being said, it's important that we follow the rules and expectations set within the office space by listening to some words of advice from PMG's Head of Culture, Pam Buyers!

::: {.panel-tabset}

## **Office Expectations** {#office-expectations}

- **Communication & Engagement**: Keep volume down in common areas to avoid disturbing others or leaking sensitive discussions, stay on top of your emails and Slack messages, and stay actively engaged during meetings (including turning your camera on during Zoom calls).

- **Kitchen & Shared Spaces**: Clean up after yourself immediately—wash your own dishes, wipe down microwaves after spills, clear your table after eating, and throw away any stray trash you see. Be mindful of strong-smelling foods like fish or Brussels sprouts when bringing lunch.

- **Shared Food & Perks**: Wait until everyone has had a chance to get food before taking seconds or packing leftovers.

- **Health & Courtesy**: Stay home when you are feeling sick to keep the rest of the team healthy.

- **Meeting & Desk Management**: Always reserve a desk ahead of time (especially when visiting another office), and end meetings on time so the next group can start promptly

## **What to Wear** {#what-to-wear}

**What to Wear (The Dos):**

- **Express Yourself Comfortably**: Wear outfits that make you feel confident and authentic, including visible tattoos (work-appropriate), piercings, and colorful hair.
- **Adapt to Your Audience**: Match your personal style with the expectations of the client or partner you're meeting with.

**What Not to Wear (The Don'ts):**

- **Avoid Unprofessional Attire**: Skip clothing that is overly revealing, shows your midriff, is excessively short, or is overly baggy. Aim for smart casual.
- **Ditch the Sleepwear**: Save pajama pants for home and opt for elevated joggers or comfortable, neat alternatives instead.
- **Keep It Respectful**: Never wear items featuring offensive text or graphics.

## **Benefits** {#benefits}

  function getTargetForHeading(heading) {
    if (heading.id) return heading;

    const section = heading.closest("section[id]");
    const sectionHeading = section && section.querySelector(":scope > h1, :scope > h2, :scope > h3, :scope > h4");

    if (sectionHeading === heading) return section;

    const baseId = "search-" + normalize(heading.textContent).replace(/\s+/g, "-").slice(0, 60);
    if (!baseId || baseId === "search-") return section || null;

    let uniqueId = baseId;
    let suffix = 2;

    while (document.getElementById(uniqueId)) {
      uniqueId = baseId + "-" + suffix;
      suffix += 1;
    }

    heading.id = uniqueId;
    return heading;
  }

  function getSectionContext(target, title) {
    const labels = [];
    let parent = target.parentElement && target.parentElement.closest("section[id]");

    while (parent) {
      const heading = parent.querySelector(":scope > h1, :scope > h2, :scope > h3, :scope > h4");
      const label = heading ? heading.textContent.trim() : "";

      if (label && label !== title) labels.unshift(label);
      parent = parent.parentElement && parent.parentElement.closest("section[id]");
    }

    return labels.slice(-2).join(" › ");
  }

  function getSectionExcerpt(target, title) {
    const copy = target.cloneNode(true);

    copy.querySelectorAll("script, style, button, nav, h1, h2, h3, h4").forEach(function(node) {
      node.remove();
    });

    const text = copy.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    const withoutRepeatedTitle = text.toLowerCase().startsWith(title.toLowerCase())
      ? text.slice(title.length).trim()
      : text;

    if (withoutRepeatedTitle.length <= 170) return withoutRepeatedTitle;
    return withoutRepeatedTitle.slice(0, 167).replace(/\s+\S*$/, "") + "…";
  }

  function buildSearchIndex() {
    const content = document.getElementById("quarto-document-content") || document.querySelector("main");
    if (!content) return curatedSections;

    const curatedById = new Map(curatedSections.map(function(section) {
      return [section.id, section];
    }));
    const curatedByTitle = new Map(curatedSections.map(function(section) {
      return [normalize(section.title), section];
    }));
    const seen = new Set();
    const entries = [];
    const tabTitles = new Set();

    function addEntry(target, title) {
      if (!target || !target.id || seen.has(target.id) || !title) return;

      const curated = curatedById.get(target.id) || curatedByTitle.get(normalize(title));
      const contentSource = target.matches("h1, h2, h3, h4")
        ? target.closest("article, section, .callout, .weather-card, .neighborhood-card") || target.parentElement
        : target;

      seen.add(target.id);
      entries.push({
        id: target.id,
        title: curated ? curated.title : title,
        terms: curated ? curated.terms : [],
        context: getSectionContext(target, title),
        excerpt: getSectionExcerpt(contentSource, title),
        searchText: contentSource.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(),
        order: seen.size
      });
    }

    content.querySelectorAll(".panel-tabset .nav-link[data-bs-target]").forEach(function(tab) {
      const selector = tab.getAttribute("data-bs-target");
      const target = selector ? document.querySelector(selector) : null;
      const title = tab.textContent.trim();

      tabTitles.add(normalize(title));
      addEntry(target, title);
    });

    Array.from(content.querySelectorAll("h1, h2, h3, h4"))
      .forEach(function(heading) {
        const target = getTargetForHeading(heading);
        const title = heading.textContent.trim();

        if (!tabTitles.has(normalize(title))) addEntry(target, title);
      });

    return entries;
  }

  const sections = buildSearchIndex();

  const tabSections = {
    "local-options": "Local Options",
    "suburban-options": "Suburban Options",
    "finding-an-apartment": "Apartment Search",
    "move-in-deals": "Fees, Deposits, and Move-In Deals",
    "electricity": "Electricity",
    "driving-through-dallas": "Driving Through Dallas",
    "dart-tolltag": "Public Transit and TollTag",
    "airports": "Airports",
    "weather": "Weather in Texas",
    "vehicle-registration": "Register Your Vehicle",
    "license": "Driver's License"
  };

  function findTabByTitle(title) {
    return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".panel-tabset .nav-link[data-bs-target]"))
      .find(function(tab) {
        return normalize(tab.textContent) === normalize(title);
      });
  }

  function tabForPanel(panel) {
    if (!panel || !panel.id) return null;
    return document.querySelector('[data-bs-target="#' + panel.id + '"]');
  }

  function activateGuideSection(sectionId, shouldScroll) {
    const semanticTab = tabSections[sectionId]
      ? findTabByTitle(tabSections[sectionId])
      : null;
    const directTarget = document.getElementById(sectionId);
    const directPanel = directTarget && directTarget.closest(".tab-pane");
    const tab = semanticTab || tabForPanel(directPanel);

    if (!tab && !directTarget) return false;
    if (tab && tab.getAttribute("aria-selected") !== "true") tab.click();

    if (shouldScroll) {
      const selector = tab && tab.getAttribute("data-bs-target");
      const panel = selector ? document.querySelector(selector) : null;
      const scrollTarget = directTarget || panel || tab.closest(".panel-tabset");

      window.requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        scrollTarget.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      });
    }

    return true;
  }

  function normalize(text) {
    return text
      .normalize("NFD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/&/g, " and ")
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, " ")
      .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
      .trim();
  }

  function searchableWords(text) {
    const ignored = new Set([
      "a", "an", "and", "are", "can", "do", "for", "how", "i", "in",
      "is", "it", "my", "of", "on", "the", "to", "what", "where", "with"
    ]);

    return normalize(text)
      .split(" ")
      .filter(function(word) {
        return word.length > 1 && !ignored.has(word);
      });
  }

  function singular(word) {
    if (word.length > 4 && word.endsWith("ies")) return word.slice(0, -3) + "y";
    if (word.length > 4 && word.endsWith("es")) return word.slice(0, -2);
    if (word.length > 3 && word.endsWith("s")) return word.slice(0, -1);
    return word;
  }

  function wordMatches(queryWord, candidateWord) {
    const queryRoot = singular(queryWord);
    const candidateRoot = singular(candidateWord);

    return queryRoot === candidateRoot ||
      (queryRoot.length >= 4 && candidateRoot.startsWith(queryRoot)) ||
      (candidateRoot.length >= 4 && queryRoot.startsWith(candidateRoot));
  }

  function scoreSection(section, question) {
    const q = normalize(question);
    const words = searchableWords(q);
    const title = normalize(section.title);
    const aliases = section.terms.map(normalize);
    const context = normalize(section.context || "");
    const excerpt = normalize(section.searchText || section.excerpt || "");
    const titleWords = searchableWords(title);
    const aliasWords = searchableWords(aliases.join(" "));
    const contextWords = searchableWords(context);
    const excerptWords = searchableWords(excerpt);
    let score = 0;
    let matchedWords = 0;

    if (q === title) score += 140;
    else if (title.includes(q) && q.length >= 3) score += 75;

    aliases.forEach(function(alias) {
      if (q === alias) score += 120;
      else if (alias.includes(q) || q.includes(alias)) score += 60;
    });

    if (context.includes(q) && q.length >= 3) score += 25;
    if (excerpt.includes(q) && q.length >= 4) score += 35;

    words.forEach(function(word) {
      let wordScore = 0;

      if (titleWords.some(function(candidate) { return wordMatches(word, candidate); })) wordScore = 24;
      else if (aliasWords.some(function(candidate) { return wordMatches(word, candidate); })) wordScore = 20;
      else if (contextWords.some(function(candidate) { return wordMatches(word, candidate); })) wordScore = 10;
      else if (excerptWords.some(function(candidate) { return wordMatches(word, candidate); })) wordScore = 5;

      if (wordScore) {
        matchedWords += 1;
        score += wordScore;
      }
    });

    const coverage = words.length ? matchedWords / words.length : 0;
    if (coverage === 1 && words.length > 1) score += 30;
    if (coverage < 0.5) score *= 0.35;

    return { score: score, coverage: coverage };
  }

  function getMatches(question) {
    if (!normalize(question)) return [];

    return sections
      .map(function(section) {
        const result = scoreSection(section, question);
        return {
          section: section,
          score: result.score,
          coverage: result.coverage
        };
      })
      .filter(function(match) {
        return match.score >= 5 && match.coverage > 0;
      })
      .sort(function(a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score || a.section.order - b.section.order;
      });
  }

  function goToSection(section) {
    const target = document.getElementById(section.id);
    if (!target) return;

    const tabPanel = target.classList.contains("tab-pane")
      ? target
      : target.closest(".tab-pane");

    if (tabPanel && !tabPanel.classList.contains("active")) {
      const tab = document.querySelector('[data-bs-target="#' + tabPanel.id + '"]');
      if (tab) tab.click();
    }

    closeSearch(false);

    target.scrollIntoView({
      behavior: "smooth",
      block: "start"
    });

    const highlightTarget = target.matches("h1, h2, h3, h4")
      ? target
      : target.querySelector("h1, h2, h3, h4") || target;

    highlightTarget.classList.add("search-hit");
    if (!section.id.startsWith("tabset-")) {
      history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + encodeURIComponent(section.id));
    }

    setTimeout(function() {
      highlightTarget.classList.remove("search-hit");
    }, 1600);
  }

  function closeSearch(returnFocus) {
    panel.hidden = true;
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    document.body.classList.remove("search-is-open");
    input.value = "";
    clearButton.hidden = true;
    results.innerHTML = "";

    if (returnFocus) toggle.focus();
  }

  function openSearch() {
    const navigation = document.querySelector(".top-nav");
    if (navigation) panel.style.top = Math.max(0, navigation.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) + "px";

    panel.hidden = false;
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    document.body.classList.add("search-is-open");
    renderResults(input.value);
    input.focus();
  }

  function createResultHeading(text) {
    const heading = document.createElement("p");
    heading.className = "nav-search-results-heading";
    heading.textContent = text;
    return heading;
  }

  function renderQuickSearches() {
    const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
    const chips = document.createElement("div");

    wrapper.className = "nav-search-suggestions";
    chips.className = "nav-search-chips";
    wrapper.appendChild(createResultHeading("Popular searches"));

    quickSearches.forEach(function(question) {
      const button = document.createElement("button");
      button.type = "button";
      button.className = "nav-search-chip";
      button.textContent = question;
      button.addEventListener("click", function() {
        input.value = question;
        clearButton.hidden = false;
        renderResults(question);
        input.focus();
      });
      chips.appendChild(button);
    });

    wrapper.appendChild(chips);
    results.appendChild(wrapper);
  }

  function renderResults(question) {
    results.innerHTML = "";
    clearButton.hidden = !input.value;

    if (question.trim().length < 2) {
      renderQuickSearches();
      return;
    }

    const matches = getMatches(question).slice(0, 6);

    if (!matches.length) {
      const empty = document.createElement("div");
      empty.className = "nav-search-empty";
      empty.innerHTML = "<strong>No close match found</strong><span>Try fewer words or search for a topic such as apartments, parking, weather, or registration.</span>";
      results.appendChild(empty);
      return;
    }

    results.appendChild(createResultHeading(
      matches.length + (matches.length === 1 ? " result" : " results") + " for “" + question.trim() + "”"
    ));

    matches.forEach(function(match, index) {
      const button = document.createElement("button");
      const copy = document.createElement("span");
      const topLine = document.createElement("span");
      const title = document.createElement("strong");
      const arrow = document.createElement("span");

      button.type = "button";
      button.className = "nav-search-result";
      button.dataset.resultIndex = String(index);

      copy.className = "nav-search-result-copy";
      topLine.className = "nav-search-result-topline";
      title.textContent = match.section.title;
      arrow.className = "nav-search-result-arrow";
      arrow.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      arrow.textContent = "→";

      if (match.section.context) {
        const context = document.createElement("span");
        context.className = "nav-search-result-context";
        context.textContent = match.section.context;
        topLine.appendChild(context);
      } else if (index === 0) {
        const bestMatch = document.createElement("span");
        bestMatch.className = "nav-search-result-context";
        bestMatch.textContent = "Best match";
        topLine.appendChild(bestMatch);
      }

      topLine.appendChild(title);
      copy.appendChild(topLine);

      if (match.section.excerpt) {
        const excerpt = document.createElement("span");
        excerpt.className = "nav-search-result-excerpt";
        excerpt.textContent = match.section.excerpt;
        copy.appendChild(excerpt);
      }

      button.appendChild(copy);
      button.appendChild(arrow);

      button.addEventListener("click", function() {
        goToSection(match.section);
      });

      button.addEventListener("keydown", function(event) {
        const buttons = Array.from(results.querySelectorAll(".nav-search-result"));

        if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === "ArrowUp") {
          event.preventDefault();
          const direction = event.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1;
          const nextIndex = (index + direction + buttons.length) % buttons.length;
          buttons[nextIndex].focus();
        } else if (event.key === "Escape") {
          event.preventDefault();
          closeSearch(true);
        }
      });

      results.appendChild(button);
    });
  }

  toggle.addEventListener("click", function() {
    if (panel.hidden) openSearch();
    else closeSearch(true);
  });

  input.addEventListener("input", function() {
    renderResults(input.value);
  });

  input.addEventListener("keydown", function(event) {
    if (event.key === "ArrowDown") {
      const firstResult = results.querySelector(".nav-search-result");
      if (firstResult) {
        event.preventDefault();
        firstResult.focus();
      }
    } else if (event.key === "Enter") {
      const matches = getMatches(input.value);
      if (matches.length) {
        event.preventDefault();
        goToSection(matches[0].section);
      }
    } else if (event.key === "Escape") {
      event.preventDefault();
      closeSearch(true);
    }
  });

  clearButton.addEventListener("click", function() {
    input.value = "";
    renderResults("");
    input.focus();
  });

  closeButton.addEventListener("click", function() {
    closeSearch(true);
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.top-nav a[href^="#"]').forEach(function(link) {
    link.addEventListener("click", function(event) {
      const sectionId = decodeURIComponent(link.getAttribute("href").slice(1));

      if (activateGuideSection(sectionId, true)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        history.pushState(null, "", "#" + encodeURIComponent(sectionId));
      }
    });
  });

  Object.keys(tabSections).forEach(function(sectionId) {
    const tab = findTabByTitle(tabSections[sectionId]);
    if (!tab) return;

    tab.addEventListener("click", function() {
      history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + encodeURIComponent(sectionId));
    });
  });

  window.addEventListener("hashchange", function() {
    const sectionId = decodeURIComponent(window.location.hash.slice(1));
    if (sectionId) activateGuideSection(sectionId, true);
  });

  document.addEventListener("click", function(event) {
    if (!panel.hidden && !panel.contains(event.target) && !toggle.contains(event.target)) {
      closeSearch(false);
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(event) {
    if (event.key === "Escape" && !panel.hidden) {
      closeSearch(true);
      return;
    }

    const target = event.target;
    const isTyping = target instanceof HTMLInputElement ||
      target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement ||
      target.isContentEditable;

    if (!isTyping && (event.key === "/" || ((event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === "k"))) {
      event.preventDefault();
      openSearch();
    }
  });

  if (window.location.hash) {
    activateGuideSection(decodeURIComponent(window.location.hash.slice(1)), true);
  }

});
</script>

:::
